description: Remove the link that uses the given device port (a port belongs to at most one link).

device.description: Device name, e.g. R1, S1, PC1 (case-insensitive).

port.description: Interface name, e.g. GigabitEthernet0/0, FastEthernet0/1, FastEthernet0 (abbreviations such as Gi0/0 are expanded).

name: remove_link
title: Remove link
